name: Insatiable (CR +2)
body:
Exposure to the powers of the Consumption can taint the forms of mortals and immerse them in the incessant agony of the composite entities. Stripped of the anchors that hold the creature to existence and belonging, an insatiable becomes a husk of its former self, its overwhelmed soul and body committed to the destruction of all things in order to achieve the destruction of itself. This abominable motivation instills the creature with unreal alien power, feeding from the twisted will of the unmakers to facilitate the absolute elimination of the multiverse.

Insatiable is an acquired template that can be applied to any living creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

An insatiable uses all the base creature’s statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Challenge Rating: Same as base creature +2.

Type: The creature’s type changes to undead and it gains the augmented and psionic subtypes. Do not recalculate base attack bonuses, saves, or skill points.

Alignment: Chaotic evil.

Senses: An insatiable gains lifesense out to 60 feet.

Armor Class: An insatiable’s natural armor bonus increases by +3.

Hit Dice: Change all of the creature’s racial Hit Dice to d8s. All Hit Dice derived from class levels remain unchanged. As undead, insatiable use their Charisma modifiers to determine bonus hit points (instead of Constitution).

Defensive Abilities: In addition to normal undead traits, an insatiable gains channel resistance +4, fast healing 5, and power resistance equal to 11 + it’s total CR. This power resistance does not apply against mind-affecting powers or powers which would suppress its rejuvenation. In addition, the insatiable possess the following ability.

Rejuvenation (Ex)

A destroyed insatiable restores itself in 2d4 days. The only way to permanently destroy an insatiable is to affect it with a spell, power, or other effect which can suppress or remove the confused condition or insanity effects. Once it has been affected by such an effect, an insatiable can be slain normally if it is killed within 24 hours afterwards.

Weaknesses: Insatiable possess the following weakness:

Tormented Thoughts (Ex)

An insatiable is not immune to mind-affecting effects or effects that suppress or remove the confused condition or insanity effects. Such effects automatically bypass the insatiable’s power resistance. The insatiable cannot gain immunity to such effects and takes a –4 penalty on saving throws against such effects.

Special Attacks: An insatiable gains the following special attacks:

Dynamic Optimization (Su)

Any ability (including spells or powers) that the insatiable possesses which would deal energy damage instead deals an equal amount of force damage.

Unravel Energies (Su)

Whenever an insatiable hits a creature or object with a melee attack, the struck creature or object is subjected to a targeted dispel psionics effect (ML equal to the insatiable’s Hit Dice).

Ability Scores: +4 Str, +2 Dex, +4 Wis, +6 Cha. As an undead creature, an insatiable has no Constitution score.
